_readme: 1. Drop the logo in public/sponsors/ (SVG preferred, otherwise a transparent PNG at least 600px wide).
2. Add an entry to the matching tier below and set "logo" to the filename, e.g. "acme.svg".
3. Leave "logo" as null to render the name in a styled placeholder card instead.
Tiers render in the order listed here. Add or rename tiers freely.
